targets.rawSql: select count(*) from train_neo
select count(*) from train_neo where is_sentry_object  = True;
select count(*) from train_neo where is_potentially_hazardous = True;
select min(miss_distance_km) as minimum_missed_distance  from train_neo;
select max(relative_velocity_kps) as fastest_velocity from train_neo;

WITH neo_window AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM train_neo
  WHERE close_approach_date::date
        BETWEEN  CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' AND CURRENT_DATE 
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(relative_velocity_kps) AS avg_velocity,
    AVG(miss_distance_km)      AS avg_distance
  FROM neo_window
)
SELECT
  n.name,
  n.close_approach_date,
  n.relative_velocity_kps,
  n.miss_distance_km,
  n.is_potentially_hazardous,
  CASE
    WHEN n.is_potentially_hazardous = true
     AND n.relative_velocity_kps > s.avg_velocity
     AND n.miss_distance_km > s.avg_distance
    THEN true
    ELSE false
  END AS highlight
FROM neo_window n
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY n.close_approach_date desc;

SELECT
  close_approach_date::date AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_potentially_hazardous = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hazardous_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_potentially_hazardous = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonhazardous_count
FROM train_neo
WHERE close_approach_date::date
      BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' AND CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY close_approach_date::date
ORDER BY close_approach_date::date;

SELECT close_approach_date::date as approach_date,
       COUNT(id) as daily_count
FROM train_neo 
WHERE close_approach_date::date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND close_approach_date::date <= CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY close_approach_date::date
ORDER BY approach_date;

SELECT 
    miss_distance_km,
    relative_velocity_kps,
    CASE 
        WHEN is_potentially_hazardous = true THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS hazardous_flag
FROM train_neo 
WHERE close_approach_date::date 
      BETWEEN current_date - interval '30 days' AND current_date;

panels.title: Monthly Closest Miss Distance vs Velocity (Colored by Hazardous)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('year', close_approach_date::date) AS time,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_potentially_hazardous = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hazardous_asteroids,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_potentially_hazardous = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_hazardous_asteroids
FROM train_neo
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Number of PHOs and Non-PHOs Over Year

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE_PART('year', close_approach_date::date) AS year,
       AVG(miss_distance_km) AS avg_miss_distance
FROM train_neo
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

select 
		distinct(extract(month from close_approach_date::date)) as month,
		max(relative_velocity_kps) as max_rel_vel_captured
from train_neo
where extract(year from close_approach_date::date) = extract(year from current_date)
group by month;

panels.title: Monthly Max Relative Velocity for Current Year

targets.rawSql:
select 
		distinct(extract(month from close_approach_date::date)) as month,
		min(miss_distance_km) as max_rel_vel_captured
from train_neo
where extract(year from close_approach_date::date) = extract(year from current_date)
group by month;

panels.title: Monthly Minimum Miss Distance over Current Year

targets.rawSql:
select 
	tn.name,
	tn.close_approach_date,
	pt.probability_being_falsely_hazardous as false_probability,
	pt.probability_being_truely_hazardous as true_probability
from prediction_table pt
join train_neo tn on tn.id = pt.id::bigint
where tn.close_approach_date::date between current_date - interval '7 days' and current_date
order by tn.close_approach_date desc
limit 20;
select training_date from model_training_logs order by training_date desc limit 1;

WITH last_model_trained_date AS (
  SELECT training_date  
  FROM model_training_logs 
  ORDER BY training_date DESC 
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pt.actual = pt.model_prediction) AS correct_predictions,
  COUNT(*) AS total_predictions,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pt.actual = pt.model_prediction) / COUNT(*), 
    2
  ) AS accuracy_percent
FROM prediction_table pt
JOIN last_model_trained_date lmtd 
  ON pt.trained_model_date_used = lmtd.training_date;
select model_name from model_training_logs order by training_date desc limit 1;

SELECT 
    recall * 100 AS recall_pct,
    accuracy * 100 AS accuracy_pct,
    f1_score * 100 AS f1_score_pct,
    precision * 100 AS precision_pct
FROM model_training_logs
ORDER BY training_date DESC
LIMIT 1;
select created_at from neo_data_drift order by  created_at desc limit 1;

WITH last_recorded_drift AS (
    SELECT created_at 
    FROM neo_data_drift
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    feature,
    drift_status,
    CASE 
        WHEN drift_status = 'No Drift' THEN 0
        WHEN drift_status = 'Moderate Drift' THEN 1
        WHEN drift_status = 'High Drift' THEN 2
    END AS drift_level
FROM neo_data_drift
WHERE created_at = (SELECT created_at FROM last_recorded_drift);

with last_recorded_drift as (
	select created_at from neo_data_drift
	order by  created_at desc
	limit 1
)
select 
	feature, 
	feature_type,
	method
from neo_data_drift 
where created_at = (select created_at from last_recorded_drift);

WITH last_recorded_drift AS (
    SELECT created_at 
    FROM neo_data_drift
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    feature,
    ROUND(psi::numeric, 4) AS psi
FROM neo_data_drift
WHERE created_at = (SELECT created_at FROM last_recorded_drift)
ORDER BY psi DESC;
